messages:
Alex W: Heads up — we've got a handful of customers reporting streams drop + immediate reconnect, and the reconnects are counting against per-route quotas (so they're getting double billed). Spike shows up ~15:42 UTC for cp-prod/* routes.
Priya K: Ugh. Any error payloads or close reasons from the clients?
Alex W: Mostly `ECONNRESET` / `stream closed by server`. I grabbed a trace: `trace_id=tx_9f2...` with close reason `server_idle_timeout`.
Sam T: Is this the new retry-budget change we rolled last week? Could be aggressive immediate reconnects when cache warms off.
Diego M: I pulled logs: `service:inference AND event:stream_close AND reason:*` — see high `client_reconnect` tag after a `503` fallback.
Alex W: The tricky part: our quota middleware counts each new connection as a request unit before the runtime attaches a session id. So transient disconnect -> reconnect ends up charging twice.
Priya K: Minimal repro: `curl -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" https://api/redwood/v1/streams -v` then kill TCP -> client reconnects -> second connection shows as separate request in quota logs.
Sam T: We should treat reconnects that happen within the same session token + short window (e.g., 30s) as the same logical request for billing. Add a reconnect dedupe at the quota layer.
Diego M: Agree, but quota logic lives in edge proxy (nginx-ish) while session attach happens in runtime. We can either: (1) move session attach earlier, (2) add a short reconnect grace window in the proxy, or (3) emit a reconnect marker and later dedupe in billing job.
Priya K: Option (2) seems fastest: proxy keeps ephemeral reconnect cache keyed by `session_cookie` or `x-client-id` for 30s. If same session reconnects, skip quota increment.
Sam T: We need telemetry to validate: console dashboards currently only show connection counts and token usage. There's no `reconnect_reason` or `deduped=true` tag to verify any change.
Alex W: Exactly — console needs two things: a reconnect_reason dimension and a boolean `quota_deduped` tag in the token-level breakdown. Without that we can't prove customers saved money.
Diego M: I'll open a small API to attach `reconnect_reason` on the server close path and emit it to traces/metrics. PR coming.
deploy-bot: canary/backoff-policy-v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T16:05:12Z
Priya K: For telemetry, here's a quick datadog query suggestion: `sum:stream.connections{env:prod,route:cp-prod*} by {reconnect_reason}` and `sum:billing.units{quota_deduped:true}` — but we don't currently populate those tags.
Sam T: UX question: Console rollout — should we surface `reconnect_rate` and a suggested `grace_window` toggle in per-route settings? Product likes small toggles.
Alex W: Yes add a per-route toggle defaulting to 30s with an explain blurb: "Treat reconnects within the grace window as the same session to avoid duplicate billing". Also add an audit log entry when policy is changed.
Diego M: Implementation plan: (A) emit reconnect_reason metric + trace field (small change, runtime) (B) add proxy grace-window flag (edge) (C) backend dedupe for post-facto corrections (billing) if we miss it in real time. I'll take A and help with B.
Priya K: I'll prototype console mockups for the toggle and the per-token breakdown with `quota_deduped` column.
Sam T: Can we add a temporary alert: if reconnect_rate > 10% and average session length < 20s then page eng-platform?
Alex W: Good call. Add alert to the `streaming-health` policy.
infra-bot: alert created: streaming-health/reconnect-anomaly (threshold: 10% reconnect rate, window: 5m)
Alex W: OK let's track this: Diego (runtime + metrics) + Sam (proxy) + Priya (console) + me for rollout comms. Aim for staging changes this week, prod next Tue.
Priya K: I'll post mock screenshots to #product-design once ready.
Sam T: I'll schedule a short sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to coordinate changes.
Diego M: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/452 — adds `reconnect_reason` to trace and emits `metric.stream.reconnect_reason`.
Alex W: Thanks all. Follow-ups: add e2e that kills connection and ensures quota not doubled, update docs on billing behavior. :thumbsup:
